items.headline: Hochul bans high-concentration, synthetic 7-OH kratom sales
items.excerpt: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed legislation banning most products containing more than 2% or 1 milligram of the potent alkaloid 7-hydroxymitragynine.

items.headline: Data shows number of lithium-ion battery fires in Albany County
items.excerpt: Newly shared data from Albany County showed there have been 15 incidents where a lithium-ion battery possibly caused a fire in 2026. The data comes as more officials have been urging people to use their devices properly to prevent any further fires.

items.headline: Several sentenced in fatal shooting of Albany man
items.excerpt: Several people were sentenced in Albany County Court on Monday for the fatal March 2025 shooting of 24-year-old Jamier Allen. The Albany County District Attorney's Office said the group conspired to lure Allen to a wooded area and "execute" him.

items.headline: Popular Rensselaer hot dog shop back in business after temporary closure
items.excerpt: Hot Dog Charlie's in Rensselaer on Monday announced it will be reopening its doors after temporarily closing last week.

items.headline: New York sues HUD over new housing assistance rules
items.excerpt: New York Attorney General Letitia James and a coalition of states filed a lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development and Secretary Scott Turner to block a rule change that requires strict citizenship verification for federal housing assistance.

items.headline: Albany schools expand food security with new pantry
items.excerpt: A new food pantry has officially opened in the City School District of Albany.
